summary.name: Artbreeder
summary.one_liner: Artbreeder is a collaborative AI image creation tool for making characters, artworks and other images by mixing and editing existing ones.
use_cases: blending two images into a new one
making collages from shapes, images and text
editing facial or visual traits via genes
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a web tool for creating images with AI, citing 14M users and 300M images. Its Splicer and Splicer2 tools mix images and let users edit their 'genes' (listed examples include Age, Gender and Blue), with Splicer2 offering branching and editing in one interface. A Collage tool builds images from simple shapes, images and text. The site also has an explore section, a community feature for following creators and sharing work, daily-theme contests with voting, and remix parties.
notable: Splicer2 mixes, branches and edits images in one interface
Gene-based editing of image traits such as age, gender and color
Collage tool combines shapes, images and text
caveats: Pricing page is linked but its contents are not in the page text, so plan details are unknown
Listed in a directory as a GAN-based breeding tool; the page itself does not describe the underlying model
